verdict.rationale_short: Both regime gates cleared simultaneously for the first time in ten sessions — SPX closed at 7,483.23 (above 7,460) and VIX closed at 16.45 (below 17), formally activating the morning's conditional BUY trigger. However, the conditional BUY requires NFP confirmation: June payrolls (consensus 100–115K; ADP missed at 98K) print tomorrow at 8:30 AM ET before a 3-day unhedgeable July 4 holiday gap. HOLD is maintained with specific longs (META AI cloud, GOOGL Dow tail, NVDA half-size) and QQQ puts as binary hedge. BUY upgrade activates on July 7 if NFP is Goldilocks (80–120K, wages +0.2–0.3%).

bear_case: Tech profit-taking (Nasdaq -0.66%) on the same session where regime gates cleared for the first time in ten sessions signals that the two-speed market structure (XLC/XLF up; XLK/semis down) is a rotation risk, not a signal that the AI capex cycle's beneficiaries are entering a sustained re-rating. H1 2026's semiconductor leaders gained 80%+ in six months; at Nasdaq P/E ~28x, those valuations require Q2 earnings to confirm acceleration rather than plateau. The ISM miss (53.3 vs. 54.0 consensus; May's 54.0 high-water mark not eclipsed) combined with ADP (98K vs. 110K) establishes a pattern where every 2026 data point is arriving below Wall Street's forecasts — a pattern that historically precedes earnings disappointment. If NFP prints hot tomorrow (>150K, wages +0.4%) through the 3-day July 4 gap at Nasdaq ~28x P/E, the July 1 dual-gate clearance becomes a false breakout and SPX returns below 7,460 before the market can respond. Invalidation: NFP prints 80–120K (Goldilocks), wages +0.2–0.3%, unemployment ≤4.3% — the bear case collapses, the BUY activates July 7, and Q3 earnings season (GOOGL, META, MSFT, AMZN mid-to-late July) becomes the primary long-conviction driver. If SPX holds above 7,460 through July 7 and VIX stays below 17, the ten-session gate struggle retrospectively reads as a bottoming process, not distribution.
